title: Restricting inputs and outputs: schemas, allowlists and limits

videos.script: Tarefa's job intake reads what a client wrote, asks a model to sort it into a category and suggest a price, and shows the result. {{title}} The model sits between two boundaries. What goes in, and what comes out. {{boundaries}} On the way in, the request is narrowed. Known fields, closed lists, a length limit, and no invisible characters. {{inputs}} On the way out, the reply is checked against a schema before anything uses it. The lab's replies were written by the course, each one to be caught by a different rule. {{schema}} One wraps its JSON in a friendly sentence. One adds a field nobody asked for. One links to a host that only looks like Tarefa's. {{failures}} When a reply fails, the code decides what happens next. It tries once more and says what was wrong. Then it stops, and a person takes the job. {{retry}}
